title: kbmon --receipt prints the agent's one-line receipt and an alert fingerprint
goal: kbmon.py --receipt prints one JSON object with line and fingerprint from the alerts of the querylog, sessions and host panels, or of the panels --panel names; line is at most 200 characters and passes redact.redact; line names up to two alert messages, how many more there are and the command python3 _tools/kbmon.py --once --panel NAME for the state on ask; fingerprint changes only when the set of alert kinds and ids changes; it writes no file and exits 0

gates.question: Which panel does the receipt line's command name when alerts come from several panels?
What form does the fingerprint take?
options: 12 hex characters of a sha256 of the sorted kinds and ids
the sorted kind:id pairs joined as plain text
gates.recommendation: 12 hex characters of a sha256 of the sorted kinds and ids
gates.answer: 12 hex characters of a sha256 of the sorted kinds and ids

notes: Plan 2026-10-19: premise on the base: kbmon.py has no --receipt (exit 2). Prototype in the discovery session: a receipt line of 99-186 characters (about 25-46 tokens at 4 characters a token, an estimate) from the querylog and sessions panels took 1.4 s warm and 6.5 s cold; querylog alone 0.23 s. A planted distill.log line 'apply --push: refused: ...' with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT gives the delivery alert whose message carries the line's text, so the planted secrets reach the receipt's input. The mod (ST-fobzhr5o) keeps the last fingerprint; kbmon stays read-only.
